Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Quite a low academic level compared to University of Copenhagen. Did differ from class to class though

questions.answer: The teachers are very authoritative compared to UCPH. The classes were not based oin any stated curricular and they were quite unstructured.
